notes.title: Introducing Beyond The Evil: Director's Cut
notes.content:
[h1]THE DIRECTOR'S CUT[/h1]

[p]What's up gamers! It's been a minute since we came with fresh news to the players. Today we're happy to announce that a new version of the game is coming: The [b]Director's Cut[/b]! The release date will be announced in the future with the partnership of QuByte Interactive. Check it out what's new![/p]

[h2]What's New?[/h2]
New scenes are coming to the game, graphics remaster & more, bringing more variety to the players and better experiences through the game time. Here's the full detailed list:

[h1]NEW SCENES[/h1]

[b]The Game got new scenes![/b] This includes new parts that weren't in the base game and [b]chapter reworks[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/bb1024b0799f8b7c2b5f46d7a777fa258d2ca87c.png[/img]
Chapter 4, [b]The Explorer[/b]

This includes [b]new puzzles & horror scenes[/b] - making the game more versatile with less repetitive scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/93964c166414a645cc6ef9ad41d503ac56c8d8b7.png[/img]
Chapter 4, [b]The Explorer[/b]

New puzzle variations including [b]VHS Tapes & Flashlight usage[/b].

[h1]NEW GRAPHICS[/h1]
With some criticism and the upcoming release of [b]Dawn Of Fear[/b], we also remastered all in-game scenes with better lightning, post processing & optimization. Take a look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/f892108a77bbf755d6b2f652da2989cfe96f82e2.png[/img]
Chapter 2, [b]Bloodlines[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/f82508b5d7958c2100a6f011111d5bb452172ab0.png[/img]
Chapter 1, [b]The Family Prodigy[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/06070983f996e73ffb2287af635d4efc2b9841dc.png[/img]
Chapter 5, [b]Choices[/b]

[h1]NEW MECHANICS & REWORKS[/h1]
We also changed the core gameplay in some parts, including [b]new mechanics and reworks[/b] - here's the full list:

[h2]Draggable Flashlight[/h2]
Now the players can use the flashlight as their own friend to discover hidden stuff and solve the puzzles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/191cdb5594be8d088563b676d2371d5bf1a070e8.png[/img]
Chapter 2, [b]Bloodlines[/b]

[h2]Floating Icons[/h2]
To improve the interactions and visibility, we added the floating icons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/3e87c3444d0994067032235ac896171e03a24678.png[/img]
Chapter 4, [b]The Explorer[/b]

[h2]Cameras System & Fully Reworked AI System[/h2]
To improve the player experience on Chapter 5, we've reworked the AI system of Matthew Juniper and we've added one fully operating camera system to see where the masked man is going to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/22aacff92f1a0f7005ccc4e43f9b22f5b7c93df0.png[/img]
Chapter 5, [b]Choices[/b]

[h2]Puzzle Reworks[/h2]
We removed some unnecessary puzzles that were present in game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/4ae49655398a93bfb724244572ceacc0d245931a.png[/img]
Chapter 2, [b]Bloodlines[/b]

[h2]Player Changes[/h2]
We also changed the core gameplay of the player. Here's the full list of changes:

[list]
[*]Increased the running speed of the player.
[*]Removed the option to jump.
[*]Removed running on Apartment & Cafe (dreams)
[*]New tutorials for the controls
[/list]

This improves the quality of the gameplay.

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
We also fixed some bugs that were present in the last version (1.0.6), here's the Hotfix:
[list]
[*]Fixed the Controller Input (Thanks to QuByte Interactive!)
[*]Fixed some translation Issues including subtitles
[*]Fixed item names
[*]Fixed the doors position when loading game
[*]Fixed some broken models
[*]Fixed the cutscene duration when leaving the house (Chapter 2)
[*]Fixed some positions where the player could get stuck
[*]Fixed the Inventory saving
[*]Fixed some frame drops
[*]Fixed some issues when crouching
[*]Fixed the possibility to get wrong positions on examine
[*]Fixed the dynamic audio settings
[*]Synced the subtitles on cutscenes
[*]Fixed some wrong colliders
[*]Fixed some LOD issues
[*]Fixed the sensibility settings
[*]Fixed the objectives
[*]Fixed cutscene sounds
[*]Fixed wrong interaction titles
[*]Fixed the blur on chapter 5
[/list]

[h1]THE UPDATE WILL BE COMPLETELY FREE[/h1]

We hope that you players enjoy the update of the experience. Feel free to follow us on social medias and join our [b]Discord Server[/b]!

https://linktr.ee/blackhawkgames

- BHWK

notes.title: v1.0.5 is Out! | Optimization, Partial Controller Fix & More!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Everyone! New Update Is Out. Thanks to everyone who reported the errors.[/b]

[h2]OPTIMIZATION[/h2]

[b]We've changed some lightning settings in the game, resulting in more frames per second.[/b]
 - Examples: (Nvidia Geforce RTX 2060)
 MAIN MENU (From ~65FPS to ~95FPS)
 THE FAMILY PRODIGY (From ~54FPS to ~90FPS)
 THE EXPLORER (From ~70FPS to ~110FPS)

[h2]RESOURCES[/h2]

 - Increased the brightness in the lost place scene.

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]

 - Fixed the controller bug when interacting doors.
 - Fixed one box collider in the family prodigy scene.
 - Fixed some captions in the game.

[h2]TO DO (NEXT UPDATES):[/h2]

 - Fix Controller Sensivity Settings.


- BlackHawk Games.

https://linktr.ee/blackhawkgames

notes.title: New Upcoming Beta Test and Update for Beyond The Evil!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Everyone! We're finally finishing the Chapter 01 of Beyond The Evil! Here is the newest things:[/b]

[h1]Beyond The Evil - Test 2[/h1]

[b]The game is having another test just to make sure that the first chapter don't have any annoying bug or bad optimization on the chapter scenes.

This Test will be open for all the Streamers/Youtubers that want to participate! To participate, enter our discord server and send one message on the #general chat, then we'll contact you:[/b]
https://discord.gg/wcnPScbg2S

[h1]CHAPTER 01: The Prologue[/h1]

[h2]THE CONTINUATION[/h2]

[b]The Chapter 01 is now finished with one new scene that will be showcased later on the steam page and on the news later.[/b]

[h2]New Letters[/h2]

[b]Changed a lot of letters and added new ones to add more atmosphere and feeling to the scenes![/b]

[h2]Puzzle Remake[/h2]

[b]Since the first test got finished, we got the conclusion that some of the puzzles of the game were a bit messed up and too hard to be done.
Also we changed the quantity of keys of the first scene and increased the number of notes to make the puzzles harder.[/b]

[h2]Lightning Optimization and Improvement[/h2]

[b]We've managed to improve the house lightning and the optimization on the First Scene (Abandoned House).[/b]

[h1]RESOURCES[/h1]

[b] -  Updated the Store Page Screenshots.
 -  Updated the Game Image.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40806512/de5350cfa05ec32eb4afbe055322deea112cb93b.jpg[/img]

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

[b] -  Fixed one key that didn't showed up the correct name on the inventory.
 -  Fixed one bug that made the scene disappear when walking on the living room.[/b]
